_meta.spec: docs/G7_REFERENCE.md 13.9c-14 (new rotorless stealth gunship for the counter-nanite teams) + 13.9c-15 (hardpoints: nose, mirrored side pair, rear) + 13.9c-13 (grounded numbers, no gimmicks)
_meta.note: CN Vanta: name and every number PROVISIONAL (owner 13.9c-14). Trained at the Sentinel barracks (cn_sentinel_barracks, inside the CN facility) and based on its rooftop pad (CnFacility.roof_pad): one Vanta per pad, launches / lands / refuels / rearms there. Combat only ACQUIRES targets for it (fire-control 'weapon' g7_vanta_fc, e.ammo held at 0 so Combat never fires it); every shot comes from a hardpoint in sim/systems/vanta7.gd (rules.g7_vanta).

cn_vanta_a.name: CN Vanta Gunship
cn_vanta_a._note: AIRV7 PROVISIONAL: 14 m faceted rotorless attack craft (four ducted lift / vector fans, two in the hull sides, two at the tail), 2 crew in tandem. Human A: cool grey-blue stealth finish.

cn_vanta_b.name: CN Vanta Gunship
cn_vanta_b._note: AIRV7 PROVISIONAL: Human B variant: heavier armour, a little slower, olive-sand finish (same airframe and hardpoints).

g7_vanta_fc.name: Vanta fire control
g7_vanta_fc._note: AIRV7: target acquisition only (Combat picks / chases the target; Vanta7 fires the hardpoints). Never fires: the Vanta's e.ammo stays 0.

g7_vanta._note: AIRV7 PROVISIONAL numbers. Hardpoints (owner 13.9c-15): nose (main) and rear chosen independently; the two side hardpoints are ONE mirrored choice (both sides carry and fire the same item). Mounts in metres on the airframe (f forward, r right, z up). Arcs in degrees from the nose (side arcs are for the right side; the left side mirrors).
g7_vanta._deck_note: display: render alt fraction for a craft standing on the 11.6 m barracks deck (114 px of the art's 150 px flight altitude, manifest 'altitude')
